description: AI-generated image detection, served through the image-forensics /v1/detect API and a Hive-compatible /api/v2/task/sync layer over the same detector. The expected endpoints are POST /v1/detect, POST /api/v2/task/sync and GET /readyz; suppliers MAY expose more (GET /v1/models, the Sightengine compatibility layer) but consumers MUST NOT depend on it. Responses are probabilities, not verdicts. This service is model-agnostic: suppliers choose their own detector and crop policy, so scores, calibration, and detection quality vary and are not guaranteed by the protocol; each native response carries a pipeline_fingerprint identifying the weights and crop policy. Every response, including errors, is a single JSON object.

rpc_types.backend_hint: image-forensics service on :8000 (image-forensics-service, endpoints.detect enabled); mount at /
rpc_types.notes: Only POST /v1/detect, POST /api/v2/task/sync (Hive envelope; Authorization: token is accepted and ignored) and GET /readyz are expected. Request body is multipart/form-data with media (file), or media_base64 on /v1/detect; url sources are off by default and MUST NOT be relied on. Deepfake detection is not part of this service.

serving.backend: Any server exposing POST /v1/detect, POST /api/v2/task/sync and GET /readyz with the request/response shapes of the OpenAPI document in specs[1]. Recommended: image-forensics-service with endpoints.detect enabled and its Hive compatibility layer on (ONNX Runtime, torch, or NVIDIA Triton Inference Server runtimes). Suppliers choose their own AI-generation detector; no specific weights are mandated. The operator is responsible for the license of the model they serve.

healthcheck.notes: Functional probe: a 64x64 solid PNG. Proves the detector scored an image; the score is not asserted.

serving.notes: Recommended model: Community Forensics commfor-384 (MIT) with the default five-crop policy and max aggregation. If you already run Triton, the triton image needs no GPU on the service side. Keep image URL fetching disabled. It is recommended to isolate the model behind pokt-ml-sidecar and to front it with the HA RelayMiner. See the docs in specs[0] for the full runbook.
